title: From Street View Imagery to Street Quality Indicators: Vision Language Inference for the Suburban 15-minute City
abstract: arXiv:2608.20026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Streetscape quality has become a central concern in contemporary urban planning, particularly within the framework of the pedestrian-friendly 15-minute city, where walkability and public-space quality are increasingly recognized as key determinants of urban performance. However, assessing streetscape qualities across large suburban and peri-urban territories remains challenging due to the time and resource demands of conventional field surveys. This paper presents a planning-oriented assessment of streetscape qualities in the north-eastern periphery of Nice (France) using the latest release of SAGAI (Streetscape Analysis with Generative AI), an open-source workflow that leverages vision-language models (VLMs) for large-scale streetscape analysis from Google Street View imagery. translated_title: 从街景图像到街道质量指标：面向郊区15分钟城市的视觉语言推断
translated_abstract: 街道景观质量已成为当代城市规划中的核心关注点，尤其是在以步行为导向的15分钟城市框架下，步行性和公共空间质量日益被视为城市绩效的关键决定因素。然而，由于传统实地调查在时间和资源上的高需求，评估大型郊区和城郊区域的街道景观质量仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了一种面向规划的街道景观质量评估方法，以法国尼斯东北部郊区为例，使用了最新版本的SAGAI（基于生成式AI的街道景观分析）——一个开源工作流，利用视觉语言模型（VLMs）从谷歌街景图像中进行大规模街道景观分析。新版本通过改进图像采集、地理一致的视图生成和多视图支持，解决了原始框架的局限性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于视觉语言模型的开源工作流SAGAI的新版本，用于从街景图像中大规模评估郊区街道质量，并以法国尼斯东北部为例进行了规划导向的实证分析。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an improved open-source workflow SAGAI leveraging vision-language models for large-scale streetscape quality assessment in suburban areas, demonstrated through a case study in northeastern Nice, France.
